page.overview:
Who is Micah?

Micah was seven years old when his parents allowed him to listen to an opera about the Battle of Corrin. Discovering that it painted Bashar Abulurd Harkonnen in an unfavourable light. He reported his parents to the Dune Watch network and they were indefinitely detained for spreading propaganda to their child. He was rewarded with an evening watching the gladiator games in Baron Vladimir Harkonnen's private box.
